name: neonplan3d
description: 3D floor plan for Home Assistant: draw your home in the built-in editor (rooms, walls, doors, windows, furniture, roof) and see and control lights, covers, windows, climate, media, sensors and cameras live in a neon 3D view – as a sidebar panel and dashboard card.

paragraphs: by Mastershort – draw your home right inside Home Assistant and live in it as a neon 3D house: lights glow in their colours, blinds and curtains move, doors and windows open, cameras watch, the TV shows what is playing, energy flows through the walls – and you can simply talk to it. No external tools, no cloud, made for wall tablets – old Fire tablets included.
▶️ Try the online demo – in your browser, with invented demo data: turn the house, switch lights, open the editor. Nothing to install.
📖 Manual: English · Deutsch (also here: manual.md, anleitung.md) 💬 Community: Discord – show your 3D home, ask, share ideas 🗺️ What comes next: Roadmap · What changed: Changelog
features: 🎙️ Talk to your house (new, free) – tap the microphone: "Show the living room", "Where is the washing machine?", "Show the front door camera". Anything else ("turn on the hall light") goes to Home Assistant's Assist,…

🎬 Live director – the wall tablet shows by itself what happens: the doorbell rings and the view flies to the front door and looks through its camera; someone at a camera, the washer done, a warning. Every event is…
⏪ Time travel – replay the last day or week in the house: lights, doors, motion, the robot's run.
🚶 Walk through the house at eye level, with keys or a touch stick.
🔋 Energy in the walls – solar, battery, grid and wallbox as glowing cables, holograms with day curves.
